_about: The Padma system, batch 1 (Stage 1, the user's approval of 2026-09-29): the Ganges–Padma from the frame's west edge to the Meghna, and the Gorai, Madhumati, Arial Khan, Mahananda and Bhagirathi. Geometry from the pinned rivers snapshot, the pilot extract and this system's own extract (tools/sources/osm-bangladesh-rivers-padma.geojson, the ways under geometry.extract); every chosen way carries a name, name:bn, name:en or wikidata tag for its river, or belongs to its waterway relation. Card values: the NCTB books first; where the books are silent, BWDB, then JRCB; where the two books disagree, the row stays null (pending) and ⓘ gives both (decision 2).

gangaPadma.identified: One chain of eleven ways from the pinned rivers snapshot, every link sharing a node: 134518612 and 1030338943 tagged Ganga / «গঙ্গা নদী» / Ganges (relation 1236345, main_stream), the rest «পদ্মা নদী» / Padma River. 1030338943 is the snapshot's version 2, which reaches 88.0350°E; the newer way 1563083730 overlaps it by 1.2 km and is not drawn. The chain ends on the node where way 82854640 (the line `padma`) begins. Drawn dashed outside Bangladesh, as COD-AB draws the border. Not drawn: 1077525067 and 1077525068, unnamed side streams near the barrage.

padma.identified: OSM way 82854640, named «পদ্মা নদী» (name:en «Padma River»; its name:bn tag reads «গঙ্গা নদী»), from the Jamuna–Ganges confluence to the Meghna. Its end must lie within 3 m of a vertex of the Meghna chain.

entities.review: The card is the Ganges–Padma as B-GEO's «পদ্মা» paragraph describes it. Entry and course are null: the books disagree on where it enters Bangladesh (B-GEO: the north-west of Kushtia, after about 145 km along the border; B910: through Chapainawabganj) — both in ⓘ. Distributaries are null: B-GEO lists six «প্রধান শাখানদী» with the Gorai, B910 eleven of the «নিম্নগঙ্গা» without it (ⓘ). Length is null, as for the Jamuna: which stretch is «পদ্মা» differs even inside B-GEO; BWDB gives 121 km for NC-32 (Daulatdia–Chandpur) and 230 km for NW-27 (the border to Daulatdia), JRCB 230 km in Bangladesh (row ৬), bn Wikipedia (rev 9125110) 341 km. Tributaries: BWDB NW-27's list for the Ganges reach; NC-32 lists five small rivers of the lower reach (ইছামতি (মানিকগঞ্জ), ইলিশমারী, জয়পাড়া খাল, কাটাখালী (মুন্সিগঞ্জ), তালতলা), none drawn. Confluence: «দৌলতদিয়ার নিকট» (B-GEO) and «গোয়ালন্দের নিকট» (B910) name one place — Daulatdia is in Goalanda upazila (BWDB NC-32) — so the row is shown as on the Jamuna's card; the ⓘ line on the Jamuna–Ganges meeting gives both. Mouth: «চাঁদপুরের কাছে» (B-GEO) and «চাঁদপুরে» (B910) agree; BWDB's two entries put the junction in Chandpur Sadar (NC-32) and Matlab Uttar (SE-17). Other names: bn Wikipedia's «কীর্তিনাশা» and BWDB's local name «কুতুবপুর (মাদারীপুর অংশে)» are not on the card.

entities.review: B-GEO answers every row; BWDB's list has no ভাগীরথী or হুগলি entry and JRCB's table no row. The other name is null: B-GEO writes «ভাগীরথী (হুগলি নদী)», one river, while B910 lists «ভাগীরথী, হুগলি» as two (ⓘ). The drawn line (OSM relation 1243337, Hooghly, alt_name Bhagirathi) runs to the sea, as B-GEO has it; its head is 7.4 km from the Ganges line, near Jangipur, not at Dhulian (ⓘ).
